_comment: Copy this file to trips/<slug>.json (files starting with _ are ignored). Delete keys you don't need except the required ones: slug, title, region, country, tagline, summary, type, days, totalKm, hours, difficulty, bestSeason, waypoints.
title: My New Trip
tagline: One-line hook shown on the card: A → B → C, X km, what makes it special.
summary: Two or three sentences describing the ride.
_type_options: loop (returns to start; segments = number of waypoints) or one-way (segments = waypoints - 1)
timings: Forest closures, check posts, permits, fuel stops
cautions: Wildlife, weather, traffic, anything that bites
